**Synopsis:**
A US-led economic campaign — combining an oil export blockade, expanded secondary sanctions, and financial network disruption — is severely squeezing Iran's economy. Iranian crude exports have collapsed from ~1.7M bpd to ~260K bpd. The rial has more than halved in value, inflation runs at ~70%, and Iran reportedly has only ~2 months of gasoline supply remaining. UAE trade channels have been shut. Iran faces a potential economic meltdown and internal social unrest, while simultaneously engaging in active military exchanges with US forces. Neither side has shown willingness to concede, but the economic deterioration is pushing toward a potential inflection point ahead of US midterm elections.
